```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
if (!exists("CAP")) CAP <- c(
  executive = paste(
    "Retained-model OOF performance for the PPV response family and",
    "resultant PPA. N is the number of common OOF pairs; OOF RMSE is",
    "reported in the physical unit shown. Delta RMSE is the reduction",
    "relative to t=0 on the log10(response) scale, and Delta R2 is the",
    "corresponding increase in OOF R2. PPV.L, PPV.T, and PPV.V are retained",
    "because they define the component targets used to construct scenarios."
  ),
  performance = paste(
    "OOF performance of the inverse-OOF-RMSE-weighted ensemble at the",
    "response-specific retained iteration $t^*$, defined as the first",
    "iteration attaining the maximum OOF $R^2$. $N$ is the number of OOF",
    "observation--prediction pairs; $R^2=\\operatorname{Cor}^2(z,",
    "\\hat z_{\\mathrm{OOF}})$. Log-scale RMSE is computed on",
    "$z=\\log_{10}y$; physical RMSE uses the back-transformed OOF point",
    "predictions and is reported in mm/s for PPV and g for PPA."
  ),
  conditioning = paste(
    "OOF comparison over the same sample between the independent",
    "formulation $t=0$, which uses the physical covariates, and the retained",
    "formulation $t^*$, which may include p50 companion-response predictions.",
    "$N$ is the number of common OOF observation--prediction pairs. Both RMSE",
    "values are calculated on",
    "$\\log_{10}(response)$; $\\Delta\\mathrm{RMSE}=100[1-",
    "\\mathrm{RMSE}_{t^*}/\\mathrm{RMSE}_{t=0}]$ and",
    "$\\Delta R^2=R^2_{t^*}-R^2_{t=0}$. The retained iteration is selected",
    "by OOF $R^2$, not by RMSE."
  ),
  bands = paste(
    "Empirical quantiles of the signed OOF residual",
    "$z-\\hat z_{\\mathrm{OOF}}$ from the retained formulation. $q_{50}$,",
    "$q_{90}$, and $q_{95}$ are additive offsets on the $\\log_{10}$ scale;",
    "the p90/p50 and p95/p50 columns are the multiplicative factors",
    "$10^{q_p-q_{50}}$."
  ),
  learnersPPV = paste(
    "Formal SSEL OOF metrics at each PPV response's retained iteration",
    "$t^*$. Column names are retained from `metrics.csv`: `response`",
    "identifies the modeled amplitude; `method` is the exact SSEL method",
    "identifier; `n` is the training-row count; `rmse` is the root-mean-square",
    "OOF error; and `r2` is the squared sample correlation between observations",
    "and OOF predictions. Because the responses are modeled as",
    "$z=\\log_{10}y$, `rmse` has $\\log_{10}(response)$ units; `r2` is",
    "dimensionless. Rows comprise the five base learners and the",
    "`ensemble.R2` and `ensemble.RMSE` formulations."
  ),
  learnersPPA = paste(
    "Formal SSEL OOF metrics at each PPA response's retained iteration",
    "$t^*$. Column names are retained from `metrics.csv`: `response`",
    "identifies the modeled amplitude; `method` is the exact SSEL method",
    "identifier; `n` is the training-row count; `rmse` is the root-mean-square",
    "OOF error; and `r2` is the squared sample correlation between observations",
    "and OOF predictions. Because the responses are modeled as",
    "$z=\\log_{10}y$, `rmse` has $\\log_{10}(response)$ units; `r2` is",
    "dimensionless. Rows comprise the five base learners and the",
    "`ensemble.R2` and `ensemble.RMSE` formulations."
  )
)
if (!exists("TABS")) TABS <- c(
  performance = "OOF performance",
  conditioning = "Independent vs retained formulation",
  bands = "Residual-quantile adjustments",
  learnersPPV = "PPV base learners and ensembles",
  learnersPPA = "PPA base learners and ensembles"
)
DATASET <- "QDS"
METHOD <- "ensemble.RMSE"
LEARNERS <- c("ranger", "earth", "gbm", "gamSpline", "glm")
ENSEMBLES <- c("ensemble.R2", "ensemble.RMSE")
.MODEL_CONFIG <- jsonlite::read_json(
  file.path(root, "scripts", "manifest.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE
)
RESPONSES <- as.character(.MODEL_CONFIG$responses$names)
RESPONSE_LABELS <- c(
  ppv = "PPV",
  ppvL = "PPV.L",
  ppvT = "PPV.T",
  ppvV = "PPV.V",
  ppa = "PPA",
  ppaL = "PPA.L",
  ppaT = "PPA.T",
  ppaV = "PPA.V"
)
if (!setequal(names(RESPONSE_LABELS), RESPONSES) ||
    anyDuplicated(c(LEARNERS, ENSEMBLES))) {
  stop("metrics: response labels or method identifiers are invalid.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
PathSummary <- file.path(root, "data", "summary")
PathIter <- file.path(root, "data", "iter")
UNITS <- unlist(jsonlite::read_json(
  file.path(root, "data", "domains", "units.json"),
  simplifyVector = TRUE
)[c("ppv", "ppa")])
if (any(!dir.exists(c(PathSummary, PathIter))) ||
    any(!c("ppv", "ppa") %in% names(UNITS))) {
  stop("metrics: model-product contract is incomplete.", call. = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
RESPONSES <- c("ppv", "ppvL", "ppvT", "ppvV", "ppa")
if (any(!RESPONSES %in% RESPONSES.ALL)) {
  stop("metrics: executive responses are absent from the model manifest.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
EXECUTIVE <- TRUE
```
